critical_code_review_comments: SignupSalon.jsx: Slug auto-fill logic uses useEffect with form.slug_touched flag — clean and idempotent. The slugify() helper correctly strips invalid chars, collapses repeats to single hyphens, trims leading/trailing hyphens, and caps at 40 chars (matches the server-side _SLUG_RE constraint from iter17).

SignupSalon.jsx submit(): On success it calls setAccessToken(data.access_token) + setTenantSlug(data.tenant.slug) + localStorage.setItem('miracurl_tenant', slug), then window.location.assign('/dashboard') so AuthContext rebootstraps cleanly. This is the correct pragmatic choice — confirmed working in test (dashboard renders new tenant context immediately on the next page load).
SignupSalon.jsx error UX: 422 Pydantic validation errors (array of {msg}) are flattened to a ' · ' joined string in catch — good handling of FastAPI's nested error shape.

Login.jsx mode='login' block: link-signup-salon is the primary CTA (rose, bold, font-semibold), show-signup-btn is correctly de-emphasised as secondary (smaller, sky, in a separate text block below) — matches the spec.
Minor (not blocking): SignupSalon `Field` component duplicates the `Field` definition already in Login.jsx — consider promoting to a shared component in /components/ui if a third page reuses it.

Minor: signup-toggle-password (eye icon) sits inside the trailing div but the slug input also has no trailing — the icon for slug is identical to other inputs, OK. No a11y label on the toggle button — minor a11y miss (add aria-label='Show password' / 'Hide password').
